Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` - Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits - Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model - Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files - Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed - Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority - Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call - Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in - Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders - Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8 - Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2 - Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock - Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh - Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user - Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first - Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested - Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine - Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL - Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text - Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card - Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS - Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind` - Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is

items.name: v2.1.300
items.summary: ## What's changed - Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt - Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime - Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back - Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right - Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off - Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type` - Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before - Added the `prompt.change` mod hook, raised when the prompt box's text changes without a typed edit: a recalled history entry, a clear, an undo, or a plugin's fill - Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did - Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window - Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running - Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted` - Fixed `claude agents` not refreshing any pull request's status when the data for one of them came back incomplete - Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once - Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation - Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child - Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft - Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume - Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login` - Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories - Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does - Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short - Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`) - Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage - Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being recorded as typed in the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event and interaction span, and in session title requests - Fixed a note meant for Claude about mod hot-reloading appearing in the transcript as if you had typed it - Fixed agent hooks ignoring their `model`: aliases like `haiku` now resolve, a subagent's model no longer overrides it, and an unavailable model falls back to

items.name: v2.1.299
items.summary: ## What's changed - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents - Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later - Added `$.prompt.media` so a `prompt.submit` hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt - Added `$.session.identity()` for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed `forceLoginOrgUUID` lists that organization - Added `size`, `weight`, `mono` and `tabular` to a mod's `Text` and named spacing steps (`xs` to `xl`) to its `Box`; `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight` - Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish - Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives - Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; a bare `/model`, `/effort` or `/fast` there now opens a picker - Added a "safe mode" line to the agents view peek panel for background sessions started with `--safe-mode` - Added a one-time note when plan mode won't ask before most edits or commands because bypass permissions is available - Added `--disallow-tools` and a `disallowed_tools` case field to `claude plugin eval` to keep specific built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs - Added support for turning off the attribution block in Claude Desktop's Code tab: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in the `env` of a Claude apps gateway's `code` policy - Added a field to the attribution block in Claude Code sessions behind a Claude apps gateway; remove the block with `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` - Added a `queue` door to the `session.append` mod hook, so a mod can make the transcript's queue records differ from the prompt as sent - Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin validate` naming a mod's hooks that are skipped where an organization manages Claude Code - Added `/usage` warnings for max effort, workflows, always-on context and large tool results - Fixed the error for a denied cloud session, which could point to the wrong organization when a key from `apiKeyHelper` was in use - Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request - Fixed a mod that submits a prompt at the end of every turn keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, an interrupt, or the end of the host's conversation - Fixed cloud sessions sometimes showing the model's follow-up text after a tool group's one-line label - Fixed the Write and Edit tools creating a mod in a session's mods folder without asking in accept-edits mode when the config directory's path has no `.claude` in it - Fixed installed mods that kept running in an open session after being turned off remotely; they now unload between turns - Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions failing on a message stopped while its `UserPromptSubmit` or mod `prompt.submit` hooks were still running (regression in 2.1.296) - Fixed an agent teammate started without a description keeping part of a credential from its prompt in the task description shown for it - Fixed the claude.ai view of a Remote Control or cloud session freezing when a large batch of events could not finish uploading over a slow connection - Fixed a sandboxed shell

items.name: v2.1.296
items.summary: ## What's changed - Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode - Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request - Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name - Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room - Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn - Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions - Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins - Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings - Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295) - Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read - Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere - Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted - Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag - Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string - Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal - Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open - Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through - Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run - Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order - Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1 - Fixed workflow scripts silently truncating results, agent options and other values nested deeper than about 20,000 levels, and deeply nested results writing huge task output files - Fixed a plugin's served `$` methods running in the main session's working directory instead of the calling agent's, and ignoring the turn their calling hook holds - Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused - Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit - Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal

sources.excerpt: v2.1.309 ## What's changed - Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command - Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink - Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config` - Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions - Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open - Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd` - Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell - Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse - Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse - Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do - Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink - Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start - Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running - Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode - Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting - Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse - Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc` - Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed - Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization - Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository - Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line - Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume` - Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command - Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched - Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug - Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript - Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>` - Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell - Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command - Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients - Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's v2.1.308 ## What's changed - Bug fixes and reliability improvements v2.1.307 ## What's changed - Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21` - Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back - Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]` - Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect - Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in - Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting - Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried - Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running - Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results - Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted - Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted - Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions - Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set - Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description - Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions - Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses - Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds - Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file - Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions - Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab - Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session - Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held - Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error - Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work - Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load - Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authenticati v2.1.306 ## What's changed - Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables - Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools v2.1.305 ## What's changed - Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset - Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it - Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag - Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up - Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran - Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings - Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model - Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit - Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give - Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal - Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume` - Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals - Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner - Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression) - Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG` - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open - Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor` - Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept - Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text - Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from - Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpSer

• Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's setModel(), and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds

• Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file

• Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions

• Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab

• Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with --use-anthropic-git-proxy committing a .claude/settings.local.json left in the clone by an earlier session

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held

• Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error

• Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work

• Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load

• Improved web search errors in cloud and self-h

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.306
items.summary:
• Fixed claude -p inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.305
items.summary:
• Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections

• Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS so unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

• Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of --tools (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it

• Fixed /effort and /autocompact settings not applying when the model name differed from a modelOverrides value by letter case or a [1m] tag

• Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up

• Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw ENOSPC file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran

• Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's setMcpServers being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings

• Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model

• Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit

• Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give

• Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed pipeline() and parallel() agents instead of serving them from the run's journal

• Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in /resume after switching conversations with /resume

• Fixed /usage rows being cut off in narrow terminals

• Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner

• Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with Resource temporarily unavailable when TERM is set (a 2.1.300 regression)

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through GIT_CONFIG

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open

• Improved /usage: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and f applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and /doctor

• Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept

• Improved a mod's Image to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its alt text

• Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing w now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later claude remote-control start that uses the saved mode says where it came from

• Changed allowedMcpServers to stop filtering managed-mcp.json stdio servers that use ${VAR} only in env: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use deniedMcpServers to keep it off

• Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their allowed-tools when your organization's managed settings set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly

• Changed the /artifacts delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete,

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.304
items.summary:
• Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin

• Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked

• Added e.isReadOnly to a mod's tool.check event, set when the tool call is read-only

• Added /auto-mode-setup: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions

• Added /claude-api managed-agents-secure, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything

• Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)

• Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it

• Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in /config

• Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a sandbox.filesystem.denyRead glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a [user-id] route folder

• Fixed rm -r of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (/Volumes, /media, WSL's /mnt/c) not getting the safety prompt that rm -rf /Applications gets

• Fixed CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed

• Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past --max-turns, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one

• Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded

• Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no key were redrawn unchanged

• Fixed mod sharing in the built-in plugin-authoring skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans

• Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give

• Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as ../../…; they now show ~/… or the full path

• Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions

• Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal

• Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan

• Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions

• Fixed context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field

• Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout

• Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc

• Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error

• Fixed /privacy-settings offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error

• Fixed claude plugin details @builtin suggesting claude plugin list, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to /plugin

• Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists

• Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray .git file points at a directory that doesn't exist

• Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process

• Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.301
items.summary:
• Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS so unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting

• Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the claude-api skill, including setting up trace destinations with the ant CLI

• Added the % motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y

• Added rows to a mod's Input: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line

• Added classifier_verdict and permission_mode to OpenTelemetry tool_decision events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules

• Added classifier_category to OpenTelemetry tool_decision events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1

• Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a WorktreeCreate hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits

• Fixed the fable (and best) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model

• Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files

• Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed

• Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority

• Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call

• Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in

• Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders

• Fixed stray characters such as >0q covering the folder trust prompt, and >4m before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8

• Fixed stray GOK text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2

• Fixed switching to a model whose name contains application-inference-profile running your awsAuthRefresh command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock

• Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as claude auth status or claude plugin list exited in the middle of a token refresh

• Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user

• Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first

• Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested

• Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine

• Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL

• Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text

• Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card

Claude Code v2.1.309

• Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command

• Fixed macOS sandbox denyWrite glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink

• Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with --mcp-config

• Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions

• Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open

• Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the cd is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain cd

• Fixed an Edit(path) deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell

• Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse

• Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse

• Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do

• Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink

• Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start

• Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running

• Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from ! mode

• Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting

• Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that jq could not parse

• Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's /proc

• Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed

• Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization

• Fixed the claude remote-control status line showing HEAD as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository

• Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and --tools rules given on the leader's command line

• Fixed sessions renamed with /rename appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive --resume

• Fixed the /rewind list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through /code-review --fix, a subagent or a shell command

• Fixed /privacy-settings showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched

• Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug

• Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript

• Fixed a skill in an --add-dir folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as :

• Fixed /verify and /code-review not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell

• Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that ant beta:worker poll --on-work passes trace context to the command

• Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans f Claude Code v2.1.308

• Bug fixes and reliability improvements

Claude Code v2.1.307

• Added /claude-api api-version to move Claude API code to API version 2026-10-21

• Added the claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back

• Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT is set and the model is an alias with the [1m] suffix, such as opus[1m]

• Fixed the prompt-caching-scope beta header being sent behind custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect

• Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in claude -p on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in

• Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting

• Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried

• Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running

• Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results

• Fixed /autocompact in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted

• Fixed a conversation cleared with /clear sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted

• Fixed CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions

• Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS is set

• Fixed /permissions > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description

• Fixed /help and the / command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as /claude-api instead of their short descriptions

• Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses

• Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's setModel(), and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds

• Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file

• Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions

• Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab

• Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with --use-anthropic-git-proxy committing a .claude/settings.local.json left in the clone by an earlier session

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held

• Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error

• Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work

• Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load

• Improved web search errors in cloud and self-h Claude Code v2.1.306

• Fixed claude -p inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

• Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

Claude Code v2.1.305

• Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections

• Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS so unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

• Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of --tools (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it

• Fixed /effort and /autocompact settings not applying when the model name differed from a modelOverrides value by letter case or a [1m] tag

• Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up

• Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw ENOSPC file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran

• Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's setMcpServers being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings

• Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model

• Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit

• Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give

• Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed pipeline() and parallel() agents instead of serving them from the run's journal

• Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in /resume after switching conversations with /resume

• Fixed /usage rows being cut off in narrow terminals

• Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner

• Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with Resource temporarily unavailable when TERM is set (a 2.1.300 regression)

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through GIT_CONFIG

• Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open

• Improved /usage: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and f applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and /doctor

• Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept

• Improved a mod's Image to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its alt text

• Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing w now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later claude remote-control start that uses the saved mode says where it came from

• Changed allowedMcpServers to stop filtering ma

items.name: v1.64.0
items.summary: ## 🧰 WebMCP New [page.webmcp](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-webmcp) and [frame.webmcp](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-frame#frame-webmcp) give access to the tools that a page registers through the experimental [WebMCP](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-webmcp) browser API, so you can test them like any other part of your app: ```js const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--enable-features=WebMCP'] }); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto('https://example.com'); for (const tool of await page.webmcp.tools()) console.log(tool.name, tool.description); const result = await page.webmcp.callTool('add', { a: 2, b: 40 }); console.log(result.content[0].text); // "42" ``` [Playwright MCP](https://playwright.dev/docs/getting-started-mcp) also supports WebMCP by default, with page-defined tools offered to the agent as `webmcp_<tool>`. Pass `--no-webmcp` to opt out. [`playwright-cli`](https://playwright.dev/docs/getting-started-cli) exposes them as well: ```bash playwright-cli webmcp-list playwright-cli webmcp-call search_catalog --params '{"query":"cats"}' ``` ## 🎬 Better videos Videos can now be recorded at a custom frame rate, and the decorations for actions are styled with plain CSS: ```js // playwright.config.ts import { defineConfig } from '@playwright/test'; export default defineConfig({ use: { video: { mode: 'on', size: { width: 1920, height: 1080 }, fps: 60, show: { actions: { style: { point: 'width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: red', highlight: 'outline: 2px solid #333; background: rgba(0, 128, 255, .15)', title: 'font-size: 16px', }, }, }, }, }, }); ``` - New `fps` option in [testOptions.video](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testoptions#test-options-video), [`recordVideo`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browser#browser-new-context-option-record-video) and [screencast.start()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-screencast#screencast-start). Firefox and WebKit currently capture up to 25 frames per second. - New [`style`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-screencast#screencast-show-actions-option-style) option takes CSS declarations for the `point` marker, the target `highlight` and the action `title`. It replaces the `fontSize` option, which is now deprecated. - The cursor stays visible at the last action point, survives navigations and travels along a natural, eased path. - Videos are encoded with VP9 instead of VP8, which takes less CPU and produces smaller files of the same or better quality. - All video options are also available in [Playwright MCP](https://playwright.dev/docs/getting-started-mcp) and [`playwright-cli`](https://playwright.dev/docs/getting-started-cli). ## 🎯 Test runner - New [testProject.default](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testproject#test-project-default) option keeps a project in the config without running it by default. You can configure every browser you care about, and let a plain `npx playwright test` run just your favourite one: ```js // playwright.config.ts import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test'; export default defineConfig({ projects: [ { name: 'chromium', use: devices['Desktop Chrome'] }, { name: 'firefox', use: devices['Desktop Firefox'], default: false }, { name: 'webkit', use: devices['Desktop Safari'], default: false }, ], }); ``` ```bash npx playwright test # runs chromium only npx playwright test --project=firefox # runs firefox npx playwright test --project="*" # runs all three, for example on CI ``` - New `--shuffle` command line option schedules tests in a random order, which helps to find tests that accidentally depend on each other. ```bash npx playwright test --shuffle # Running 42 tests using 4 workers, shuffle seed 271828182 # ... # Pass the seed to reproduce the same order. npx playwright test --shuffle 271828182 ``` - New `lock` option in [test.describe.configure()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-test#test-describe-configure) adds [test locks](https://pl

items.name: v1.63.0
items.summary: ## 🔒 Test locks Tests that access a shared resource — an external service, a global account setting — can now declare a named `lock`. Tests that share a lock name never run concurrently, across files, workers and [projects](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-projects), while everything else keeps running in parallel: ```js test('update user settings', { lock: 'user-settings' }, async ({ page }) => { // never runs at the same time as other tests holding 'user-settings' }); ``` A test can hold multiple locks, and [test.describe()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-test#test-describe) accepts a `lock` for the whole group. Learn more about [test locks](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-parallel#test-locks). ## 🪟 Locate across frames [page.frameLocator()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-frame-locator) and [frame.frameLocator()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-frame#frame-frame-locator) called without a selector search in any frame of the subtree, so you no longer need to locate the iframe first: ```js // Finds the button in any frame on the page. await page.frameLocator().getByRole('button').click(); ``` The rest of the locator resolves inside a single frame, just like a regular locator, and an error is thrown when it matches elements in several frames. ## 👁️ Visible-only locators New [locator.visible()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator#locator-visible) returns a locator that matches only visible elements. It is the recommended replacement for the `:visible` CSS pseudo-class: ```js await page.locator('button').visible().click(); ``` ## 🧾 Step params and subtitles Steps now carry structured data for reporters. Playwright API steps report the target locator and call arguments, and [test.step()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-test#test-step) accepts `subtitle` and `params` options for your own steps: ```js await test.step('Login', async () => { // ... }, { subtitle: 'as admin', params: { user: 'admin' } }); ``` Reporters receive them via [testStep.subtitle](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-teststep#test-step-subtitle) and [testStep.params](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-teststep#test-step-params). For Playwright API steps, the subtitle is the locator or the navigation url — for example, `Click` with subtitle `getByRole('button')`. Both are rendered next to the step title in the trace viewer and the HTML report. ## 🖼️ Aria and screen snapshots in traces The `snapshots` option of [tracing.start()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-tracing#tracing-start) and the [testOptions.trace](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testoptions#test-options-trace) fixture option now accept an object selecting what to capture on every action: ```js // playwright.config.ts export default defineConfig({ use: { trace: { mode: 'on', snapshots: { dom: true, aria: true, screen: true } }, }, }); ``` With aria and screen snapshots recorded, the new **Display Aria** mode in the trace viewer shows the action screenshot side by side with the aria snapshot, and hovering an aria node highlights it on the screenshot. ## New APIs ### Browser and Context - [`httpCredentials`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browser#browser-new-context-option-http-credentials) now also accepts an array of credentials. The first entry matching the request origin is used, and entries without an origin match any request. - New option [`opfs`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-storage-state-option-opfs) includes the [origin private file system](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/File_System_API/Origin_private_file_system) in the storage state, so it can be persisted and restored into later contexts. - New events [page.on('dialogclosed')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-event-dialog-closed) and [browserContext.on('dialogclosed')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-dialog-closed) are emitted when a JavaScript dialog is accep

items.name: v1.62.0
items.summary: ## 🧱 New component testing model [Component testing](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-components) moves to a **stories and galleries** model. A **story** wraps your component in one specific scenario — hard-coded props, mock data, providers — and a **gallery** page that you serve renders stories on demand. The new [fixtures.mount()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-fixtures#fixtures-mount) fixture navigates to the gallery, mounts a story by id, and returns a [Locator](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator) scoped to the story's root element: ```js test('click should expand', async ({ mount }) => { const component = await mount('components/Expandable/Stateful'); await component.getByRole('button').click(); await expect(component.getByTestId('expanded')).toHaveValue('true'); }); ``` Pass a story type as a template argument to type-check its props, and use `update(props)` / `unmount()` on the returned locator to re-render or tear down within a test. ## 🛑 Cancel operations with AbortSignal Most operations and web-first assertions now accept a `signal` option that takes an [`AbortSignal`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AbortSignal), letting you cancel long-running actions, navigations, waits, and assertions: ```js const controller = new AbortController(); setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 1000); await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click({ signal: controller.signal }); await expect(page.getByText('Done')).toBeVisible({ signal: controller.signal }); ``` Providing a signal does not disable the default timeout; pass `timeout: 0` to disable it. ## 🖼️ WebP screenshots [expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-pageassertions#page-assertions-to-have-screenshot-1) and [expect(locator).toHaveScreenshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locatorassertions#locator-assertions-to-have-screenshot-1) can now store snapshots in the WebP format — just give the snapshot a `.webp` name: ```js // Visual comparisons store the golden snapshot as lossless WebP. await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot('homepage.webp'); // Standalone screenshots can trade quality for size with lossy WebP. await page.screenshot({ path: 'homepage.webp', quality: 50 }); ``` [page.screenshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-screenshot) and [locator.screenshot() (https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator#locator-screenshot) also accept `webp` as a `type`, where quality `100` (the default) is lossless and lower values use lossy compression. ## 🧩 Custom test filtering with Reporter.preprocess() New [reporter.preprocess()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-reporter#reporter-preprocess) hook runs after the configuration is resolved and before [reporter.onBegin()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-reporter#reporter-on-begin), letting a reporter mark individual tests as skipped, excluded, fixed, or failing through a [TestRun](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testrun) object: ```js class MyReporter { async preprocess({ config, suite, testRun }) { for (const test of suite.allTests()) { if (shouldSkip(test)) testRun.skip(test); } } } ``` ## 🔁 Isolated retries New [testConfig.retryStrategy](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testconfig#test-config-retry-strategy) controls when failed tests are retried. The default `'immediate'` retries as soon as a worker is free; `'isolated'` runs all retries at the end, one by one in a single worker, to minimize interference with the rest of the suite: ```js // playwright.config.ts export default defineConfig({ retries: 2, retryStrategy: 'isolated', }); ``` ## New APIs ### Browser and Context - New option [`credentials`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-storage-state-option-credentials) includes the context's virtual WebAuthn [Credentials](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-credentials) (passkeys) in the storage state, so they can be persisted and re-seeded into later contexts. ### Actions - New `s

items.name: v1.61.0
items.summary: ## 🔑 WebAuthn passkeys New [Credentials](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-credentials) virtual authenticator, available via [browserContext.credentials](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-credentials), lets tests register passkeys and answer `navigator.credentials.create()` / `navigator.credentials.get()` ceremonies in the page — no real hardware key required, works in all browsers: ```js const context = await browser.newContext(); // Seed a passkey your backend provisioned for a test user. await context.credentials.create('example.com', { id: credentialId, userHandle, privateKey, publicKey, }); await context.credentials.install(); const page = await context.newPage(); await page.goto('https://example.com/login'); // The page's navigator.credentials.get() is answered with the seeded passkey. ``` You can also let the app register a passkey once in a setup test, read it back with [credentials.get()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-credentials#credentials-get), and seed it into later tests — see [Credentials](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-credentials) for details. ## 🗃️ Web Storage New [WebStorage](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-webstorage) API, available via [page.localStorage](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-local-storage) and [page.sessionStorage](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-session-storage), reads and writes the page's storage for the current origin: ```js await page.localStorage.setItem('token', 'abc'); const token = await page.localStorage.getItem('token'); const items = await page.sessionStorage.items(); ``` ## New APIs ### Network - [apiResponse.securityDetails()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-apiresponse#api-response-security-details) and [apiResponse.serverAddr()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-apiresponse#api-response-server-addr) mirror the browser-side [response.securityDetails()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-response#response-security-details) and [response.serverAddr()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-response#response-server-addr). ### Browser and Screencast - New option `artifactsDir` in [browserType.connectOverCDP()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsertype#browser-type-connect-over-cdp) controls where artifacts such as traces and downloads are stored when attached to an existing browser. - New option `cursor` in [screencast.showActions()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-screencast#screencast-show-actions) controls the cursor decoration rendered for pointer actions. - The `onFrame` callback in [screencast.start()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-screencast#screencast-start) now receives a `timestamp` of when the frame was presented by the browser. ### Test runner - The [testOptions.video](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testoptions#test-options-video) option now supports the same set of modes as `trace`: new `'on-all-retries'`, `'retain-on-first-failure'` and `'retain-on-failure-and-retries'` values. See the [video modes table](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-use-options#video-modes) for which runs are recorded and kept in each mode. - Supported `expect.soft.poll(...)`. - New [fullConfig.argv](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-fullconfig#full-config-argv) — a snapshot of `process.argv` from the runner process, handy for reading custom arguments passed after the `--` separator. - New [fullConfig.failOnFlakyTests](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-fullconfig#full-config-fail-on-flaky-tests) mirrors the config option, so reporters can explain why a flaky run failed. - [testInfo.errors](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testinfo#test-info-errors) now lists each sub-error of an `AggregateError` as a separate entry. - New `-G` command line shorthand for `--grep-invert`. ## 🛠️ Other improvements - Playwright now supports Ubuntu 26.04. - HAR and trace recordings now include WebSocket requests. ## Browser Versions - Chromium 149.0.7827.55 - Mozilla Firefox 1

items.name: v1.60.0
items.summary: ## 🌐 HAR recording on Tracing [tracing.startHar()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-tracing#tracing-start-har) / [tracing.stopHar()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-tracing#tracing-stop-har) expose HAR recording as a first-class tracing API, with the same `content`, `mode` and `urlFilter` options as `recordHar`. The returned [Disposable](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-disposable) makes it easy to scope a recording with `await using`: ```js await using har = await context.tracing.startHar('trace.har'); const page = await context.newPage(); await page.goto('https://playwright.dev'); // HAR is finalized when `har` goes out of scope. ``` ## 🪝 Drop API New [locator.drop()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator#locator-drop) simulates an external drag-and-drop of files or clipboard-like data onto an element. Playwright dispatches `dragenter`, `dragover`, and `drop` with a synthetic [DataTransfer] in the page context — works cross-browser and is great for testing upload zones: ```js await page.locator('#dropzone').drop({ files: { name: 'note.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', buffer: Buffer.from('hello') }, }); await page.locator('#dropzone').drop({ data: { 'text/plain': 'hello world', 'text/uri-list': 'https://example.com', }, }); ``` ## 🎯 Aria snapshots - [expect(page).toMatchAriaSnapshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-pageassertions#page-assertions-to-match-aria-snapshot) now works on a [Page](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page), in addition to a [Locator](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator) — equivalent to asserting against `page.locator('body')`. - New `boxes` option on [locator.ariaSnapshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator#locator-aria-snapshot) / [page.ariaSnapshot()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-aria-snapshot) appends each element's bounding box as `[box=x,y,width,height]`, useful for AI consumption. ## 🛑 test.abort() New [test.abort()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-test#test-abort) aborts the currently running test from a fixture, hook, or route handler with an optional message. Use it when you have detected an unrecoverable misuse and want to fail the test right away: ```js test('does not publish to the shared page', async ({ page }) => { await page.route('**/publish', route => { test.abort('Tests must not publish to the shared page. Use the `clone` option.'); return route.abort(); }); // ... }); ``` ## New APIs ### Browser, Context and Page - Event [browser.on('context')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browser#browser-event-context) — fired when a new context is created on the browser. - [BrowserContext](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext) now mirrors lifecycle events from its pages: [browserContext.on('download')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-download), [browserContext.on('frameattached')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-frame-attached), [browserContext.on('framedetached')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-frame-detached), [browserContext.on('framenavigated')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-frame-navigated), [browserContext.on('pageclose')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-page-close), [browserContext.on('pageload')](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-event-page-load). ### Locators and Assertions - New option `description` in [page.getByRole()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-get-by-role) / [locator.getByRole()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-locator#locator-get-by-role) / [frame.getByRole()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-frame#frame-get-by-role) / [frameLocator.getByRole()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-framelocator#frame-locator-get-by-role) for matching the [accessible description](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#d

items.summary:
## 🎬 Screencast New [page.screencast](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-screencast) API provides a unified interface for capturing page content with: - Screencast recordings - Action annotations - Visual overlays - Real-time frame capture - Agentic video receipts
**Screencast recording** — record video with precise start/stop control, as an alternative to the [`recordVideo`](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browser#browser-new-context-option-record-video) option: ```js await page.screencast.start({ path: 'video.webm' }); // ... perform actions ... await page.screencast.stop(); ``` **Action annotations** — enable built-in visual annotations that highlight interacted elements and display action titles during recording: ```js await page.screencast.showActions({ position: 'top-right' }); ``` [screencast.showActions()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-screencast#screencast-show-actions) accepts `position` (`'top-left'`, `'top'`, `'top-right'`, `'bottom-left'`, `'bottom'`, `'bottom-right'`), `duration` (ms per annotation), and `fontSize` (px). Returns a disposable to stop showing actions. Action annotations can also be enabled in test fixtures via the `video` option: ```js // playwright.config.ts export default defineConfig({ use: { video: { mode: 'on', show: { actions: { position: 'top-left' }, test: { position: 'top-right' }, }, }, }, }); ``` **Visual overlays** — add chapter titles and custom HTML overlays on top of the page for richer narration: ```js await page.screencast.showChapter('Adding TODOs', { description: 'Type and press enter for each TODO', duration: 1000, }); await page.screencast.showOverlay('
Recording
'); ``` **Real-time frame capture** — stream JPEG-encoded frames for custom processing like thumbnails, live previews, AI vision, and more: ```js await page.screencast.start({ onFrame: ({ data }) => sendToVisionModel(data), size: { width: 800, height: 600 }, }); ``` **Agentic video receipts** — coding agents can produce video evidence of their work. After completing a task, an agent can record a walkthrough video with rich annotations for human review: ```js await page.screencast.start({ path: 'receipt.webm' }); await page.screencast.showActions({ position: 'top-right' }); await page.screencast.showChapter('Verifying checkout flow', { description: 'Added coupon code support per ticket #1234', }); // Agent performs the verification steps... await page.locator('#coupon').fill('SAVE20'); await page.locator('#apply-coupon').click(); await expect(page.locator('.discount')).toContainText('20%'); await page.screencast.showChapter('Done', { description: 'Coupon applied, discount reflected in total', }); await page.screencast.stop(); ``` The resulting video serves as a receipt: chapter titles provide context, action annotations highlight each interaction, and the visual walkthrough is faster to review than text logs. ## 🔗 Interoperability New [browser.bind()](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browser#browser-bind) API makes a launched browser available for `playwright-cli`, `@playwright/mcp`, and other clients to connect to. **Bind a browser** — start a browser and bind it so others can connect: ```js const { endpoint } = await browser.bind('my-session', { workspaceDir: '/my/project', }); ``` **Connect from playwright-cli** — connect to the running browser from your favorite coding agent. ```bash playwright-cli attach my-session playwright-cli -s my-session snapshot ``` **Connect from @playwright/mcp** — or point your MCP server to the running browser. ```bash @playwright/mcp --endpoint=my-session ``` **Connect from a Playwright client** — use API to connect to the browser. Multiple clients at a time are supported! ```js const browser = await chromium.connect(endpoint); ``` Pass `host` and
